Brooklyn Apartment Building Collapses, Killing 8: What To Know

At least eight people, including two children, died after an apartment building in Brooklyn, New York , collapsed on Wednesday. The building, located at 1321 Flatbush Avenue in Brooklyn’s Flatbush neighborhood, collapsed “into an adjacent construction site,” the New York City Fire Department (FDNY) said in a statement on social media.
